headline: Vikings Trade QB J.J. McCarthy To Giants
summary: J.J. McCarthy’s tenure in Minnesota is coming to an end. The third-year quarterback will receive a fresh start in New York via an in-season trade. McCarthy is being dealt from the Vikings to the Giants, as first reported by The Ringer’s Tom Pelissero. Minnesota will receive a 2027 fifth-round pick in return. This deal (which is now official) […]

headline: Bears call on QB3 Case Keenum in rousing victory over Eagles
summary: In his first NFL start in 1,009 days, Chicago third-string quarterback Case Keenum, 38, led the Bears to a dominant 27-7 victory over the perennial NFC heavyweight Philadelphia Eagles on Monday, a performance coach Ben Johnson labeled "extraordinary."

headline: Panthers CB Jaycee Horn Facing Extended Absence
summary: The Panthers may need to finish the 2026 season without their top cornerback. Jaycee Horn exited Sunday’s loss, and a lengthy absence is in store.
